items.headline: Winter Storm Warning issued November 9 at 9:32AM AKST until November 9 at 6:00PM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
A strong system is expected to move through the area Monday.
Temperatures below freezing combined with snow levels below 1,000 ft
are indicative of snowfall for upper elevations. Mid-level
southeasterly flow should allow for ample moisture to make it into
the Haines Borough, falling as snow at the border along the Haines
Highway. Around 2 to 3 inches of snow has fallen at the Haines Border
Crossing by 7 AM, and will continue consistently through the morning.

* WHAT...Heavy snow possible. Total
items.instruction:
If you must travel, keep an extra flashlight, food, and water in your
vehicle in case of an emergency. For the latest road conditions where
available call 511 or visit 511.alaska.gov.

items.headline: High Wind Warning issued November 9 at 4:41AM AKST until November 9 at 3:00PM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 60 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Prince of Wales Island.

* WHEN...Until 3 PM AKST this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...High winds will blow around unsecured objects, damage
property and cause power outages. Travel will be difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Strongest winds are expected to impact the
gulf coast and southern portions of the island Monday morning
through the early afternoon.
items.instruction:
Report any damage to the National Weather Service by visiting
weather.gov/Juneau/StormReports.
